name: Fast Fluid Distortion Shader
description: A GLSL shader that warps UV space with layered sine and cosine waves to fake fluid motion, cheaply enough to run behind other effects.
highlights: Each pass adds a higher-frequency wave and feeds the next, so a few lines of maths give swirling, fluid-like motion
No textures, noise lookups or simulation state: just a handful of trig calls per pixel
Later became the fluid backgrounds in the Audio-Reactive Music Video and the OpenGLApp demo
